actinic_keratosis.when_to_see_doctor: See dermatologist immediately for any persistent rough scaly patch
actinic_keratosis.notes: Can progress to squamous cell carcinoma if untreated

basal_cell_carcinoma.when_to_see_doctor: See dermatologist IMMEDIATELY - this requires professional treatment
basal_cell_carcinoma.notes: Rarely spreads but can damage surrounding tissue

darier_disease.when_to_see_doctor: See dermatologist for persistent or spreading warty bumps
darier_disease.notes: Genetic condition - manage symptoms not cure

dermatofibroma.when_to_see_doctor: See doctor if bump changes, bleeds, or grows rapidly
dermatofibroma.notes: Almost always benign - no treatment needed

epidermolysis_bullosa.when_to_see_doctor: See specialist team immediately - this is a serious genetic condition

hailey_hailey.when_to_see_doctor: See dermatologist for recurrence or spreading
hailey_hailey.notes: Chronic relapsing condition - avoid friction and heat

herpes_simplex.when_to_see_doctor: See doctor if eye involvement, frequent outbreaks, or weakened immunity
herpes_simplex.notes: Contagious - avoid touching sores and sharing items

severe: Follow-up if not improving in 48-72 hours
impetigo.when_to_see_doctor: See doctor early - highly contagious and needs antibiotics
impetigo.notes: Very contagious - wash hands and do not share towels

larva_migrans.when_to_see_doctor: See doctor as soon as possible for anti-parasitic treatment
larva_migrans.notes: Do not walk barefoot in affected areas

leprosy.when_to_see_doctor: See doctor IMMEDIATELY for any suspected leprosy - early treatment prevents damage
leprosy.notes: Highly treatable - complete treatment is critical

lichen_planus.when_to_see_doctor: See dermatologist if widespread, painful, or persistent
lichen_planus.notes: May resolve without treatment in 6-18 months

lupus.when_to_see_doctor: See doctor IMMEDIATELY - lupus requires ongoing medical management
lupus.notes: Autoimmune disease - machine diagnosis aids, doctor confirmation essential

mild: NONE - Melanoma is a medical emergency
melanoma.when_to_see_doctor: SEE DOCTOR AS EMERGENCY - Melanoma can be fatal if caught late
melanoma.notes: 5-year survival >99% when caught early, much lower when late

mild: May resolve on its own in 6-12 months
molluscum_contagiosum.when_to_see_doctor: See doctor for rapid spread, pain, or when affecting face
molluscum_contagiosum.notes: Contagious - avoid sharing towels and direct contact

mycosis_fungoides.when_to_see_doctor: See dermatologist/oncologist for persistent itchy skin patches
mycosis_fungoides.notes: Rare type of lymphoma - requires specialist evaluation

neurofibromatosis.when_to_see_doctor: See specialist for new symptoms, rapid growth, or changes

papilomatosis.when_to_see_doctor: See dermatologist if patches spread or persist

pediculosis_capitis.when_to_see_doctor: See doctor if lice persist after treatment
pediculosis_capitis.notes: Contagious - treat all close contacts and wash bedding

pityriasis_rosea.when_to_see_doctor: See doctor if rash spreads rapidly or lasts over 3 months
pityriasis_rosea.notes: Usually resolves on its own in 6-8 weeks

porokeratosis.when_to_see_doctor: See dermatologist for annual monitoring due to low cancer risk
porokeratosis.notes: Monitor regularly - small risk of malignant transformation

psoriasis.when_to_see_doctor: See dermatologist for moderate-to-severe, joint pain, or persistent plaques
psoriasis.notes: Chronic but controllable - triggers include stress, cold, infection

seborrheic_keratosis.when_to_see_doctor: See doctor if growth changes color, size, or bleeds

squamous_cell_carcinoma.when_to_see_doctor: See dermatologist IMMEDIATELY for any non-healing sore
squamous_cell_carcinoma.notes: Treatable if caught early - can spread if ignored

tinea_corporis.when_to_see_doctor: See doctor if widespread, scalp affected, or not improving in 2 weeks
tinea_corporis.notes: Contagious fungal - treat all contact areas, wash bedding

tinea_nigra.when_to_see_doctor: See doctor if patches spread or don't improve in 2-4 weeks
tinea_nigra.notes: Caused by soil fungus - wear gloves when gardening

tungiasis.when_to_see_doctor: See doctor for proper removal - do not try to remove at home
tungiasis.notes: Prevent by wearing shoes in endemic areas

vascular_lesion.when_to_see_doctor: See doctor if lesion grows, bleeds, or changes color
vascular_lesion.notes: Most are benign - laser treatment available for cosmetic concerns

nevus.when_to_see_doctor: See doctor if mole changes size, shape, color, or bleeds
nevus.notes: Use ABCDE rule: Asymmetry, Border, Color, Diameter, Evolving

pigmented_benign_keratosis.when_to_see_doctor: See doctor to confirm benign - mimics melanoma so needs examination
pigmented_benign_keratosis.notes: Considered benign but should be examined by professional

healthy_normal.when_to_see_doctor: No doctor visit needed - your skin appears healthy
healthy_normal.notes: Continue sun protection and good skincare habits

acne.when_to_see_doctor: See dermatologist if painful cysts, scarring, or no improvement in 6-8 weeks
acne.notes: Do not pop pimples - it causes scars and spreads infection

hyperpigmentation.when_to_see_doctor: See dermatologist if patches grow, darken, or appear suddenly
hyperpigmentation.notes: Sunscreen is the most important step - UV light worsens dark patches

eczema.when_to_see_doctor: See doctor/dermatologist if severe, weeping, or waking with itching
eczema.notes: Not contagious. Moisturise daily - hydration is the #1 prevention.

severe: Emergency care if throat swelling / breathlessness
urticaria.when_to_see_doctor: URGENT if swelling of lips/tongue or trouble breathing
urticaria.notes: Not contagious. Individual welts usually fade within 24 hours.

contact_dermatitis.when_to_see_doctor: See doctor if blistering, spreading, or no improvement in 1 week
contact_dermatitis.notes: Not contagious - caused by contact, not germs.

mild: Gentle hair care - avoid tight styles
severe: Specialist treatment for autoimmune hair loss
alopecia.when_to_see_doctor: See doctor if hair loss is sudden, patchy, or with scalp redness/scaling
alopecia.notes: Not contagious. Many types of hair loss are reversible when treated early.

severe: Possible nail removal in stubborn cases
Treat athlete's foot at same time
nail_fungus.when_to_see_doctor: See doctor for oral treatment - cream alone rarely cures nails
nail_fungus.notes: Contagious fungal - don't share towels/clippers; treat dif1-2 months to fully cure.

mild: Wash all bedding/clothes in hot water
scabies.when_to_see_doctor: See doctor for exact cream + treat contacts - scratching can cause infection
scabies.notes: HIGHLY contagious. Itching persists a few weeks after cure (normal).

vasculitis.when_to_see_doctor: See doctor promptly - vasculitis can affect organs if untreated
vasculitis.notes: Not contagious. Needs medical diagnosis, not self-treatment.

moderate: Blister care (sterile draining only if doctor advises)
bullous_disease.when_to_see_doctor: See dermatologist early - blistering can be serious
bullous_disease.notes: Not contagious. Never pop blisters yourself - risk of infection.

mild: Stop/review the suspect medicine (only with doctor)
severe: URGENT: rashes with mouth blisters, fever, red peeling skin
drug_eruption.when_to_see_doctor: See doctor - do not stop prescribed medicine without advice
drug_eruption.notes: Not contagious. Note any new medicine vs when rash started.

systemic_disease.when_to_see_doctor: See doctor for a general health check-up - skin changes can reflect internal conditions
systemic_disease.notes: Not contagious. The skin finding is a clue - finding and treating the cause is the cure.
